sunset.title: We moved! MarkdownUtil is now mdu
sunset.ciHint: We moved! MarkdownUtil is now mdu, and this build fails on purpose so the new address cannot be missed. Run: dotnet tool uninstall --global MarkdownUtil && dotnet tool install --global mdu (in a project with a tool manifest, use dotnet tool uninstall MarkdownUtil and dotnet tool install mdu). Sorry for the shuffle. https://github.com/capjan/mdu
sunset.scroller: WE MOVED!  MARKDOWNUTIL IS NOW MDU  -  DOTNET TOOL INSTALL --GLOBAL MDU  -  SORRY FOR THE SHUFFLE  -
lines: This is the last MarkdownUtil release. MarkdownUtil lives on as mdu, and the mdu command now comes from the mdu package.
Sorry for the shuffle. Moving house is never painless, but the move takes two commands:
In a project with a tool manifest, use dotnet tool uninstall MarkdownUtil, then dotnet tool install mdu.
Pipelines that run mdu now fail on purpose, so the new address cannot be missed.
